title: AI and Agent Engineer - Senior Associate
description:
**Position Summary**

The Senior AI and Agent Engineer will develop, integrate, test, deploy, and monitor AI-enabled applications and agents across the Microsoft ecosystem. The role is responsible for the intelligence, orchestration, actions, integrations, and behavioral quality of AI solutions.

This is an AI application engineering role, not a prompt-writing position. The successful candidate must be able to build production software, integrate enterprise systems, create evaluation frameworks, troubleshoot complex behavior, and operate deployed solutions.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**AI and agent development**

* Build and configure Copilot Studio agents, topics, actions, triggers, workflows, and generative orchestration.
* Develop AI applications using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, and supporting Azure services.
* Implement retrieval-augmented generation, structured outputs, tool use, multistep orchestration, and human approval patterns.
* Develop custom APIs, Azure Functions, connectors, and supporting application services.
* Integrate AI solutions with Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, Power Platform, and approved enterprise systems.

**Prompt, context, and behavior engineering**

* Develop system instructions, prompts, grounding logic, response structures, fallback behavior, and escalation rules.
* Implement model selection and routing based on accuracy, risk, latency, and consumption requirements.
* Design agent behavior that distinguishes between answering, recommending, requesting clarification, escalating, and taking action.
* Maintain version control for prompts, instructions, tools, actions, and model configurations.

**Testing and evaluation**

* Develop evaluation datasets with practice SMEs.
* Automate tests for groundedness, relevance, completeness, citation quality, task completion, response consistency, and escalation behavior.
* Perform adversarial testing involving prompt injection, data leakage, unsupported instructions, excessive agency, and unauthorized actions.
* Build regression tests to detect changes caused by models, prompts, source content, integrations, or application releases.
* Document known limitations and expected failure behavior.

**Operations and improvement**

* Instrument solutions for usage, latency, failures, cost, task completion, user feedback, and model behavior.
* Review production telemetry and interaction patterns.
* Investigate incidents and implement corrective changes.
* Optimize token consumption, retrieval performance, application latency, and integration reliability.
* Develop reusable agent templates, integration components, evaluation harnesses, and error-handling patterns.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong Python development skills.
* TypeScript or JavaScript development experience.
* REST APIs, JSON, OAuth, OpenAPI, webhooks, and event-driven integration.
* Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and Azure AI Search.
* Microsoft Graph, Dataverse, SharePoint, and Teams integration.
* Retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, and structured generation.
* Agent orchestration, state management, tool invocation, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Automated testing, Git, pull requests, CI/CD, and production troubleshooting.
* Application Insights, Azure Monitor, logging, alerting, and performance diagnostics.
* Understanding of prompt injection, data exfiltration, overreliance, hallucination, unsafe actions, and AI-specific failure modes.

**Preferred Experience**

* 5 or more years of software, integration, automation, or data application development.
* Demonstrated production experience with generative AI or conversational AI applications.
* Experience building applications across Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Azure.
* Familiarity with Semantic Kernel or comparable orchestration frameworks.
* Basic C# experience within the Microsoft ecosystem.
* Experience in regulated, confidential, or professional-services environments.

**Success Measures**

* Evaluation performance against approved acceptance thresholds.
* Task-completion and appropriate-escalation rates.
* Production defect and regression rates.
* Retrieval and grounding quality.
* Response latency and cost per transaction.
* Integration reliability.
* Reuse of standard components.
* Completeness of technical documentation and automated testing.
* Speed and effectiveness of incident remediation.

**Role Boundaries**

This role engineers the behavior of AI applications. Practice SMEs remain accountable for defining and validating authoritative professional content, business rules, acceptable conclusions, and circumstances requiring human review.

*Join a team of curious problem solvers that celebrates differences, leads with empathy and values inclusivity****.***

We are hiring Technical Lead for the most data-intensive parts of our platform: Ocean Visibility and/or Order Inventory Visibility (OV/IV).
  
Select which domain you are drawn to, or let us help you pick.  
  
As a Technical Lead you are the engineering owner of your team's delivery. You are accountable for what ships, when it ships and how well it is built. You set the technical direction, you hold the bar on engineering practices, and you stay hands-on in the code — typically 40–60% of your week. This is explicitly not a people management role. You will not own headcount, performance reviews, compensation or career ladders — your Engineering Manager does. You own the technical and delivery outcome of the team, and the Engineering Manager owns the people. You operate

**Who you are:**

* 8+ years building and operating production software, including 2+ years as a tech lead, staff engineer or equivalent leading a team's technical delivery.  
  + Deep backend expertise in Java (Spring Boot) and/or Go, with strong fundamentals in distributed systems and object-oriented design.

  + A track record of shipping complex, multi-quarter work on time — and of being the person who found the risk early.
  + Demonstrated ability to lift a team's engineering practices, not just your own output, through standards, review and mentorship.
  + Excellent written and verbal communication — you can write a design doc an executive and a junior engineer both understand.
  + Comfortable with influence rather than authority: you get the team to a better answer without owning anyone's performance review.
  + Fluent in Agile delivery and the tooling around it (Jira, Confluence, Git branching and rebasing).
  + Comfortable working with a distributed US–India team and with customers directly.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Own delivery  
  + Own the end-to-end technical delivery of your team's roadmap — from breaking down an epic into sequenced, atomic units of work through to production release.
  + Partner with the Product Manager and Engineering Manager to shape scope, sequence work realistically and say no to the things that will not fit.
  + Run sprint-level execution: identify risk early, surface and clear blockers, and keep commitments honest and predictable.
  + Be the single technical point of accountability when a release slips, a migration goes sideways or a customer escalation lands on the team.
  + Drive production health for your services — SLOs, on-call quality, alert hygiene, and root-cause follow-through rather than repeat firefighting.  
  Set technical direction  
  + Own the architecture of your domain: service boundaries, data models, event contracts and integration patterns, aligned with the FourKites North Star architecture.
  + Write and review design documents; make the calls that need making and document the trade-offs behind them.
  + Evaluate frameworks, tools and third-party/partner APIs; decide what we build, what we buy and what we integrate.
  + Maintain a live view of technical debt in your domain and negotiate a steady share of roadmap capacity to pay it down.
  + Design for the scale we actually run at — millions of supply chain events a day, across 80+ countries and 1,600+ global brands.

  Hold the engineering bar for the whole team

**Who we are:**

This is a Leadership role at Cognizant. We believe how you lead is as important as what you deliver. As a Frontier Transformation Lead, you will make an impact by building the reusable intellectual capital of the Frontier Capability Unit (FCU) - the offerings, methodologies, accelerators, tools and assets that give SEG's AI-native engagement model its edge - and taking that capital to market and into client delivery. * Own the asset / IP register for the unit and the Enterprise Runtime & Governance standard that assets must meet before they are published for re-use.
* Supply estimation models, productivity guidance and Assurance & Evaluation proof points into new and vendor-consolidation deals, and co-create bid support with SEG Solutioning / GSA.
* Own hyperscaler, model-partner (Anthropic, Google / Gemini, OpenAI) and Agentic Trust & Security ecosystem relationships and represent the FCU's capability to industry analysts.
* Consistently demonstrate the **Cognizant Way to Lead,** which means operating with **Personal Leadership** (building trust, collaboration, and inclusion), **Organizational Leadership** (driving vision and purpose, demonstrating a strategic and enterprise mindset, and creating and communicating a bold direction that inspires purpose), and **Business Leadership** (exemplifying client focus, managing ambiguity with accountability and results, and operating with financial acumen)

**What you need to have to be considered**

* 20+ years in IT services, with 10+ years in AI-native / GenAI engineering, solutioning or offering & IP leadership.
* Strong technical / solutioning grounding in AI-native and GenAI engineering, credible enough to set an offering roadmap and engage architects and partners.
* A proven track record of taking IP to market through pre-sales support, accelerator build, and analyst / partner engagement.
* Experience building estimation and proof-point models for bids and connecting offerings to commercial outcomes such as TCV and pricing-to-win.
* A builder-evangelist profile with market-facing scope, able to lead a direct and indirect span of 20-30 across pillar-aligned focus areas.
* Embodiment of the **Cognizant Way to Lead**: Leading Self, Leading Others, & Leading the Business
* The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The right Thing, & Own It

**These will help you succeed**

* Working knowledge of major model and cloud ecosystems — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google / Gemini, Azure, AWS and GCP.
* Ability to evaluate emerging technologies and determine enterprise readiness.
* Experience designing reference architectures, engineering standards and delivery patterns.
* Strong market-sensing skills that convert frontier technology trends into a forward offering roadmap.
* Experience industrialising reusable offerings, accelerators and methodologies that differentiate at scale.

**Work model**

At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role's business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

**Job Title:** TIG \& MIG Welder / Fabrication Specialist

**Position Summary:**

A TIG \& MIG Welder performs precise joining, fabrication, and repair of metal components using Tungsten Inert Gas (GTAW) and Metal Inert Gas (GMAW) welding techniques. The role requires strong blueprint reading, metallurgical understanding, and strict adherence to structural quality standards across steel, stainless steel, and aluminum assemblies.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Fabrication \& Setup:** Read engineering blueprints and welding symbols to plan layout, cutting, and assembly sequences. Clamp, align, and tack\-weld components using jigs and fixtures prior to final welds.
* **TIG Welding (GTAW):** Perform high\-precision welds on thin gauge metals, non\-ferrous materials (aluminum, brass, copper), and critical stainless steel joints requiring smooth, high\-integrity cosmetic finishes.
* **MIG Welding (GMAW/FCAW):** Operate semi\-automatic wire\-feed equipment for structural steel fabrication, high\-volume production, and heavy\-gauge metal joining with high deposition rates.
* **Machine Calibration:** Adjust shielding gas flow rates (Argon, $CO\_2$, or mixes), wire feed speeds, amperage, and voltage based on material thickness, alloy type, and joint configuration.
* **Post\-Weld Finishing:** Clean welds using wire brushes, grinders, and pickling paste to remove slag, spatter, and oxidation. Grind, polish, or flush welds to client specifications.
* **Quality Assurance \& Safety:** Perform non\-destructive visual tests for defects like porosity, undercut, or lack of penetration. Maintain PPE protocols (auto\-darkening helmet, respirator, leather sleeves/gloves) and workspace safety standards.

**Education \& Certification**High school diploma or trade school certification in welding technology. AWS certifications (GMAW / GTAW) or ISO/EN standard certifications are highly desirable.

**Technical Expertise**Mastery of both pulse/dip TIG and short\-arc/spray MIG processes. Proficient in blueprint reading, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD\&T), and weld defect troubleshooting.

**Physical Demands**Strong manual dexterity, steady hand control, ability to lift up to 50 lbs, and endurance for prolonged standing, bending, or working in confined spaces.

**Experience**Typically 2–4 years of combined TIG and MIG welding experience in manufacturing, automotive, aerospace, or custom metal fabrication environments.

An Arc Welder is responsible for using electrical arc welding equipment (SMAW, GMAW/MIG, GTAW/TIG, or FCAW) to join, fabricate, and repair metal components and structures according to engineering drawings, blueprints, and quality specifications.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Pre\-Welding Preparation:** Interpret blueprints, schematics, and technical drawings to determine project specs, dimensions, and welding sequences. Clean, grind, align, and bevel metal surfaces prior to welding.

* **Inspection \& Quality Control:** Conduct visual inspections and use measuring tools to evaluate completed welds for structural integrity, correct penetration, and defect freedom (cracks, porosity, undercut).
* **Equipment Maintenance:** Perform routine maintenance, cleaning, calibration, and minor repairs on welding machines, torches, regulators, and hand tools.
* **Safety \& Compliance:** Adhere strictly to occupational safety protocols, including wearing proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) such as auto\-darkening welding helmets, leather gloves, and flame\-retardant clothing. Maintain a clean and hazard\-free workspace.

**Education \& Certification**High school diploma or equivalent. Completion of a technical welding program or apprenticeship preferred. AWS (American Welding Society) certification or relevant local trade certification is a strong plus.

**Technical Skills**Proficiency in arc processes (SMAW, MIG, TIG). Ability to read engineering blueprints, weld symbols, and use measurement tools (calipers, protractors).
